message.reasoning_content: We need to determine crimes based on Chinese criminal law. Facts: selling a fake base station (伪基站) equipment, using it to send fraudulent SMS messages, impersonating banks, etc. Participants: Wang2 sold equipment, arranged others to send fraudulent SMS, paid 3200 yuan. They used a rented car to travel to various cities to send SMS. They impersonated bank hotlines, sending fraudulent messages to obtain money. This is fraud (诈骗) via telecommunications. Also illegal use of telecom equipment (非法使用专用通信设施) maybe "非法获取电信服务罪"? Actually Chinese law: "利用电信网络实施诈骗罪" is a crime: "诈骗罪" (fraud) using telecom network. Also "非法提供电信服务罪" maybe. But they also sold a fake base station equipment: that could be "非法制造、买卖、租赁专用通信设施罪" (illegal manufacturing, selling, leasing of special communication equipment). Under Article 287 of Criminal Law: "非法制造、买卖、租赁专用通信设施罪". The equipment is a pseudo base station used for illegal telecom. So Wang2 sold it, that is illegal manufacturing/selling. Also the act of sending fraudulent SMS is "诈骗罪" (fraud). Also "利用信息网络实施诈骗罪" maybe "诈骗罪" with aggravating circumstances. Also "非法获取电信服务罪"? But they didn't get service, they used equipment to send messages. The main crime is "诈骗罪". Also "非法提供电信服务罪" could apply to those providing the pseudo base station service. However the question: "这部分事实构成什么罪名？一行作答。" Likely they want the crime(s) that these facts constitute. Probably multiple: "诈骗罪;非法提供电信服务罪" or "诈骗罪;非法制造、买卖、租赁专用通信设施罪". Let's see Chinese law: Article 287: "非法制造、买卖、租赁专用通信设施的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处或者单处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" So selling pseudo base station equipment is illegal manufacturing/selling. Also using it to send fraudulent SMS is "诈骗罪" (Article 266). So answer: [罪名]诈骗罪;非法制造、买卖、租赁专用通信设施罪<eoa>
